notes: CAPABILITY-DISCRIMINATING fixture (web-research-chosen). An arithmetic expression evaluator is the canonical task where weaker models slip on edge cases that violate left-to-right intuition: right-associative ** (2**3**2==512), ** binding tighter than unary minus (-2**2==-4 in Python), overloaded unary/binary minus, negative exponents, and the error contract. Weak gate = 3 trivial expressions (a naive left-assoc evaluator passes); hidden 13-case suite probes the traps. If hidden_pass varies by actor model, this LOCATES the execution-model threshold the semver fixtures were too easy to reach.
